title: MICT launches national digital literacy campaign
content: The Ministry of Information and Communication Technology announced a new digital skills programme aimed at reducing youth unemployment across all 14 regions.

title: Urgent medicine supplies arrive at Oshakati Hospital
content: Health authorities confirmed delivery of essential clinical supplies to Oshakati Intermediate Hospital following previous distribution delays.

title: Port expansion project creates 450 local jobs
content: The Ministry of Works and Transport confirmed that the new logistics corridor development in Walvis Bay has employed over 450 local youth.

title: Southern farmers appeal for urgent drought relief
content: Commercial and communal farmers in //Kharas region face acute pasture shortages, calling for immediate intervention and emergency feed subsidies.

title: Classroom shortages delay semester start in Otjiwarongo
content: Overcrowded schools in Otjiwarongo prompt community calls for emergency prefabricated classrooms ahead of the new school term.

title: Public debate intensifies over fuel price adjustments
content: Citizens and transport operators express concern online over potential transport fare increases following latest fuel benchmark updates.

title: Canal rehabilitation restores water supply to northern villages
content: Water supply has been successfully restored to over twenty northern villages following completion of urgent canal maintenance works.

title: Home Affairs reduces passport turnaround time to 3 days
content: The Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security announced automated passport processing, drastically cutting citizen wait times.

title: Green scheme harvests exceed annual targets
content: Local youth agricultural cooperatives in Kavango East record bumper maize and wheat yields, boosting national grain reserves.

title: Bridge repair disruption causes temporary detour near Mariental
content: Motorists are advised to use alternative routes following flood damage assessment on the B1 highway.
